name: Aided Málae Fháthartaig maic Rónáin
text: Aided Málae Fháthartaig maic Rónáin names the same tale as Fingal Róndín. That work tells How Rónán Killed His Son. The Irish title means the Death of Máel Fothartaig, Rónán's son. Both titles describe a single story.

attributes.attribute: an alternate title for the tale Fingal Róndín
means the Death of Máel Fothartaig Son of Rónán

sources: MacKillop 2008, s.v. 'Aided Málae Fháthartaig maic Rónáin'

okr.objective: Link Aided Málae Fháthartaig maic Rónáin to Fingal Róndín.
key_results: Translate the title as the Death of Máel Fothartaig.
